cases.name: an invoked machine's context and initial event carry the invoke's input
cases.test: input.test.ts > input > should provide input data to invoked machines

cases.name: a spawned machine's context and initial event carry the spawn's input
cases.test: input.test.ts > input > should provide input data to spawned machines (a spawnChild with an id stands for the spawn inside assign; the reference it assigns to the context is not ported)

cases.name: a host actor receives its input and is done with the output it is answered
cases.test: input.test.ts > input > should create a promise with input (a host actor invoked by a root machine stands for the root promise actor: its pending request shows the input, and the host answers it with that input, which the parent's onDone records as the output)

cases.name: a referenced child receives the invoke's static input
cases.test: input.test.ts > input > should provide a static inline input to the referenced actor (the child's entry records the input its initial event carries, the one its context factory receives)

cases.name: a referenced child receives the invoke's input computed from the context
cases.test: input.test.ts > input > should provide a dynamic inline input to the referenced actor (the root's input is the object {count: 42}, whose member its context takes, as context_from_input reads members of an object input where the test's context takes the number itself; the child's entry records the input its initial event carries, the one its context factory receives)

excluded.test: input.test.ts > input > should create a transition function actor with input
excluded.reason: fromTransition is not ported (out of scope for the actor layer)

excluded.test: input.test.ts > input > should create an observable actor with input
excluded.reason: fromObservable is not ported (out of scope for the actor layer)

excluded.test: input.test.ts > input > should create a callback actor with input
excluded.reason: fromCallback is not ported (out of scope for the actor layer)

excluded.test: input.test.ts > input > should call the input factory with self when invoking
excluded.reason: self as data: the invoke's input factory receives self, an actor reference that JSON cannot hold, and the test compares it to the root actor

excluded.test: input.test.ts > input > should call the input factory with self when spawning
excluded.reason: self as data: the spawnChild's input factory receives self, an actor reference that JSON cannot hold, and the test compares it to the root actor
